items.zh: 张老师：大卫，你对什么感兴趣？
items.py: Zhāng lǎoshī: Dàwèi, nǐ duì shénme gǎn xìngqù?
items.en: Teacher Zhang: David, what are you interested in?

items.zh: 大卫：我对中国文化很感兴趣。
items.py: Dàwèi: Wǒ duì Zhōngguó wénhuà hěn gǎn xìngqù.
items.en: David: I'm very interested in Chinese culture.

items.zh: 张老师：你喜欢中国画吗？
items.py: Zhāng lǎoshī: Nǐ xǐhuan Zhōngguó huà ma?
items.en: Teacher Zhang: Do you like Chinese paintings?

items.zh: 大卫：很喜欢。中国画很有意思。
items.py: Dàwèi: Hěn xǐhuan. Zhōngguó huà hěn yǒu yìsi.
items.en: David: Very much. Chinese paintings are very interesting.

items.zh: 张老师：你会不会画中国画？
items.py: Zhāng lǎoshī: Nǐ huì bu huì huà Zhōngguó huà?
items.en: Teacher Zhang: Can you paint Chinese paintings?

items.zh: 大卫：一点儿也不会。我想学。
items.py: Dàwèi: Yīdiǎnr yě bú huì. Wǒ xiǎng xué.
items.en: David: Not at all. I'd like to learn.

items.py: Zhāng lǎoshī: Wǒ kěyǐ jiāo nǐ.
items.en: Teacher Zhang: I can teach you.

items.zh: 大卫：太好了！谢谢张老师。
items.py: Dàwèi: Tài hǎo le! Xièxie Zhāng lǎoshī.
items.en: David: Great! Thank you, Teacher Zhang.

items.zh: 大卫：和子，你学汉语学了多长时间了？
items.py: Dàwèi: Hézǐ, nǐ xué Hànyǔ xué le duō cháng shíjiān le?
items.en: David: Hezi, how long have you been studying Chinese?

items.py: Hézǐ: Wǒ xué le yī nián le.
items.en: Hezi: I've been studying for a year.

items.zh: 大卫：你的汉语说得很好。
items.py: Dàwèi: Nǐ de Hànyǔ shuō de hěn hǎo.
items.en: David: You speak Chinese very well.

items.zh: 和子：哪里，说得不太好。你也学了一年吗？
items.py: Hézǐ: Nǎli, shuō de bú tài hǎo. Nǐ yě xué le yī nián ma?
items.en: Hezi: Not really, I don't speak well. Have you also studied for a year?

items.zh: 大卫：没有，我才学了半年。
items.py: Dàwèi: Méiyǒu, wǒ cái xué le bàn nián.
items.en: David: No, I've only studied for half a year.

items.zh: 和子：是吗？你的汉语也不错啊。
items.py: Hézǐ: Shì ma? Nǐ de Hànyǔ yě búcuò a.
items.en: Hezi: Really? Your Chinese is also good.

items.zh: 大卫：我每天都练习，可是汉字太难了。
items.py: Dàwèi: Wǒ měi tiān dōu liànxí, kěshì Hànzì tài nán le.
items.en: David: I practice every day, but Chinese characters are too hard.

items.zh: 和子：是的，汉字是不太容易。
items.py: Hézǐ: Shì de, Hànzì shì bú tài róngyì.
items.en: Hezi: Yes, characters are not so easy.

data.topic: 语法 · Grammar (Textbook: 「是」字句(2) — 「的」字结构)

items.zh: 「的」字结构：名词/代词/形容词 + 的 = 名词性短语
items.py: "de" zì jiégòu: míngcí/dàicí/xíngróngcí + de = míngcí xìng duǎnyǔ
items.en: The '的' construction: noun/pronoun/adjective + 的 functions as a noun phrase.

items.py: Zhè shì xīn chū de.
items.en: These are newly published ones. (的 replaces the noun)

items.py: Hái yǒu hǎokàn de ma?
items.en: Are there nice-looking ones? (好看的 = nice-looking ones)

items.py: Zhè jiàn máoyī bú shì Mǎlì de.
items.en: This sweater is not Mary's. (玛丽的 = Mary's one)

items.zh: 这个照相机是大卫新买的。
items.py: Zhège zhàoxiàngjī shì Dàwèi xīn mǎi de.
items.en: This camera is the one David just bought.

data.topic: 语法 · Grammar (Textbook: 结果补语 Complement of Result)

items.zh: 结果补语由动词或形容词充任，表示动作的结果。
items.py: Jiéguǒ bǔyǔ yóu dòngcí huò xíngróngcí chōngrèn, biǎoshì dòngzuò de jiéguǒ.
items.en: A complement of result is a verb or adjective showing the outcome of an action.

items.zh: 打通：你打通电话了吗？——没打通。
items.py: dǎ tōng: Nǐ dǎ tōng diànhuà le ma? —— Méi dǎ tōng.
items.en: dǎ tōng (get through): Did you get through? — No.

items.zh: 写对：这样写，对不对？——写对了。
items.py: xiě duì: Zhèyàng xiě, duì bu duì? —— Xiě duì le.
items.en: xiě duì (write correctly): Is this right? — Yes, it's correct.

items.py: tīng dǒng: Shuō Yīngyǔ, tā tīng dǒng le.
items.en: tīng dǒng (understand by listening): Speaking English, he understood.

items.zh: 找到：你们怎么找到这儿的？
items.py: zhǎo dào: Nǐmen zěnme zhǎo dào zhèr de?
items.en: zhǎo dào (find): How did you find this place?

items.zh: 「到」作结果补语：他回到北京了。
items.py: "dào" zuò jiéguǒ bǔyǔ: Tā huí dào Běijīng le.
items.en: '到' as complement: He has returned to Beijing.

items.zh: 昨天北京大学的两个中国学生来玩儿，我们一起照相了。
items.py: Zuótiān Běijīng Dàxué de liǎng ge Zhōngguó xuésheng lái wánr, wǒmen yīqǐ zhào xiàng le.
items.en: Yesterday two Chinese students from Peking University came to visit; we took photos together.

items.zh: 北京大学的朋友说，星期天请我们去玩儿。
items.py: Běijīng Dàxué de péngyou shuō, xīngqītiān qǐng wǒmen qù wánr.
items.en: Our Peking University friends said they'd invite us over on Sunday.

items.zh: 他们在北大东门等我们。
items.py: Tāmen zài Běidà dōngmén děng wǒmen.
items.en: They'll wait for us at Peking University's east gate.

items.zh: 我们去的时候，先给他们打电话。
items.py: Wǒmen qù de shíhou, xiān gěi tāmen dǎ diànhuà.
items.en: When we go, we'll call them first.

items.zh: 你们怎么找到这儿的？——小马带我们来的。
items.py: Nǐmen zěnme zhǎo dào zhèr de? —— Xiǎo Mǎ dài wǒmen lái de.
items.en: How did you find this place? — Xiao Ma brought us.

items.zh: 我们下车以后很快就找到了这个楼。
items.py: Wǒmen xià chē yǐhòu hěn kuài jiù zhǎo dào le zhège lóu.
items.en: After getting off the bus we quickly found this building.

items.zh: 不远，坐18路车就可以到那儿。
items.py: Bù yuǎn, zuò shíbā lù chē jiù kěyǐ dào nàr.
items.en: Not far, you can get there by taking bus No. 18.
